records.rationale: Introduce the documented threat model as an initial controlled boundary.

Introduce the bounded audit evidence and incident state model behind API-side authorization. The module records redacted state and integrity evidence through a custody interface. Durable custody and an independent anchor require separate verified adapters.
alternatives: Defer the API-side model until the custody adapters are available.

records.rationale: Expose the audit evidence model from the API package so authorized server-side consumers can integrate it. This entry point adds no network route or initialized adapter.
alternatives: Require server consumers to import the internal module path.
